name: davi
description: Filters Tavily MCP search results (tavily-mcp 0.2.22, tool tavily_search) before the model reads them: one choice-model call per result scores P(keep), and results below the preset threshold are removed. Other tools, including built-in WebSearch, are not touched. Fail-open: on any error the result is left unchanged.

runpod_api_key.title: RunPod API key
runpod_api_key.description: Key for your choice endpoint on RunPod serverless. Stored in secure storage; read by the hook only at its first request.

choice_endpoint_id.title: Choice endpoint ID
choice_endpoint_id.description: RunPod serverless endpoint ID of your Jev-compatible choice-judge worker.

usd_per_second.title: Endpoint price (USD per second)
usd_per_second.description: Per-second rate of your endpoint, used for the client-side estimate and cap. Required: without it nothing is sent.

enabled.title: Enable the filter
enabled.description: Turn the search-result filter on or off without uninstalling.

preset.title: Filter preset
preset.description: Named relevance prompt + threshold. Only v1-thr0.3-dev exists (threshold 0.3).

concurrency.title: Concurrent filter calls
concurrency.description: Filter calls in flight at once per search (1-8). Default 1.

max_docs.title: Max results scored per search
max_docs.description: Results beyond this count are passed through unscored (1-50).

wall_budget_seconds.title: Time budget per search (seconds)
wall_budget_seconds.description: After this many seconds the hook gives up and the original result is used (1-60).

on_all_dropped.title: When every result is dropped
on_all_dropped.description: keep_original (default): show the original results plus a note. drop_all: remove them all.

mcp_tools.title: Tool overrides (optional)
mcp_tools.description: Comma-separated MCP tool names, optionally name=tavily|off. The Tavily tool tavily_search is filtered by default; =off excludes it; another name with =tavily is parsed as Tavily output if a hook routes it here.

log_file.title: Log file (optional)
log_file.description: Append one JSON line per search (counts and bytes only, no text or keys). Empty: stderr only.
